## PluginLibrary

Public SDK type, exported as `PluginLibrary`. Import with `import type`; the SDK has no runtime exports.

```ts
export interface PluginLibrary {
    list(options?: {
        pattern?: string;
        limit?: number;
    }): Promise<{
        name: string;
        files: PluginLibraryFile[];

    }>;
    read(options: {
        path: string;

        limit?: number;
    }): {
        path: string;
        text: string;

}
```

### PluginLibrary read

A relative library path; all native source/policy/alias guards apply again.
Text files only, at most 512 KiB/file and 512 Ki characters per response.
Offsets are UTF-16 characters. This does not OCR or convert PDFs.

```ts
read(options: {
    path: string;
    offset?: number;
    limit?: number;
}): {
    path: string;
    text: string;
    characters: number;
    offset: number;
    nextOffset: number | null;
    sha256: string;
};
```

| Parameter | Type |
| --- | --- |
| `options` | `{         path: string;         offset?: number;         limit?: number;     }` |

**Returns:** `{         path: string;         text: string;         characters: number;         offset: number;         nextOffset: number \| null;         sha256: string;     }`.

## PluginLibraryFile

Public SDK type, exported as `PluginLibraryFile`. Import with `import type`; the SDK has no runtime exports.

Read-only text sources in the host-selected course. No host paths or credentials.

```ts

    path: string;
    name: string;
    bytes: number;
```
